name: Arulan
origin: Sailing out of Pulicat, Coromandel coast
bio: Arulan is the Kaveri deckhand who packed the two lengths on one reed core. He knows what was packed rather than what the tally says, and wants a single bale he can sell on his own account.
notes: gameplay: Arulan helped pack the Kaveri's indigo cotton; Muthu is its captain and Sri Rangan owns the goods (data/inspections/case_002.json)

gameplay: Between the Kaveri and the White Border calls, Arulan offers to count cloth for smaller buyers. Back him after a fair ruling in the temenggung's name and he can put his first bale into Yusuf's sale; after a needless hold he takes a packing job instead (data/inspections/case_002.json; data/briefings/day_05_strange_sails_at_pasai.json; docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §09)
